scientific_integrity: Exact Cartier matrix, discriminant and inverse-Frobenius iteration identities are proved and reproduced by three standalone checkers; no independent mathematical audit or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified smooth three-parameter cyclic (3,5) trigonal family over the algebraic closure of F7 is classified. No full Newton or Ekedahl–Oort types, global moduli classes, or assertion outside this family.
title: A double Hasse divisor and four \(7\)-rank strata in a cyclic-trigonal genus-four family
